summary: @servicetitan/carto-tokens preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling bundle
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts the platform-specific binary, chmods it executable, and uses it to invoke a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (rotated string-array with a `WV8StW` shift function, hex-named identifiers, thousands of opcode entries) and bears no relation to the package's stated purpose of shipping DTCG design tokens for vanilla-extract, motion, and react-native. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is listed in `package.json` `files` (which allowlists only `build/vanilla-extract`, `build/motion`, `build/react-native`, and `README.md`), yet both are present in the tarball root and executed on `npm install`. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape (fetch a second language runtime specifically to execute an unreviewable obfuscated payload at install time) places attacker-controlled code on the installer's host on `npm install`, with capabilities that cannot be inspected pre-execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
